title: Encouragement
definition: Encouragement is the ministry of strengthening others with truth, hope, comfort, correction, and love.
summary: Encouragement helps others keep trusting and following Christ.
christFocus: Jesus comforts, strengthens, and restores His people, and He calls believers to encourage one another in His truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Encouragement is more than positive speech. Biblical encouragement strengthens others in the truth of God. It may include comfort, exhortation, reminder, correction, prayer, and presence.

Believers need encouragement because sin, suffering, fear, and weariness can harden or weaken the heart. Scripture calls God's people to encourage one another regularly.

Encouragement points people to Christ. It helps the discouraged remember God's promises, take the next faithful step, and persevere in hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people are silently weary, ashamed, or close to giving up. Encouragement matters because God often uses the words and presence of His people to strengthen faith.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Look for someone to strengthen today. Speak Scripture, pray with them, remind them of God's faithfulness, and encourage a concrete step of obedience or hope.
